parseCleanCheck.note: Do NOT use `| tail -3`: on a file with recovery events the parser prints `  discarded: ...` diagnostic lines AFTER the three metric lines, so tail -3 shows diagnostics instead of the metrics. grep is the only safe form.

declarationCountCheck.note: Prints '<basename>: N node types' then a table of 'Kind  count'. Truncates with '... and N more' past 15 kinds, so read the kinds you care about (FnDecl / TestBlock / ConstDecl) from the top of the table, not the tail.

stubCountCheck.note: Every stub body in the corpus is the single line `// TODO: Implement from .tri spec`. grep -c is the honest floor for 'how many stubs remain'.

doNotUse.why: Returns {"errors":0,"ok":true} on plain English prose. Verified 2026-09-09 on a 2-line English file. Never make this the only check in a criterion.
